title: Crunch! Electric Sharpener Jammed
description: Someone jammed a gummy candy into the heavy-duty pencil sharpener.

title: District Transportation Surcharge
description: District notified all afterschool clubs of a sudden $1.20 per student fuel surcharge.

title: Acid Leak! Dead Calculator Batteries
description: The reserve scientific calculators corroded over winter break. Replacement batteries needed!

title: Surprise! Math Club Alum Donation
description: A former math club champion sent a gift check to support young mathematicians!

title: Tape Marks on School Wall Fine
description: Custodial staff billed the club for special tape cleanup after club rush week.

title: PTSA Innovation Mini-Grant Awarded!
description: The Parent-Teacher-Student Association voted to award our math club an STEM enrichment grant!

title: Ink Catastrophe: Permanent Marker Rug Spill
description: An uncapped permanent marker rolled off a desk onto the classroom carpet.

title: Tournament Early-Bird Registration Rebate
description: The tournament committee processed our early submission and returned an overpayment check.

title: Missing Equipment: Digital Timers Box
description: A plastic case of backup tournament stopwatches disappeared from the club storage locker.

title: Community Sponsor: Local Bakery Donation
description: A neighborhood bakery sponsored our tournament breakfast with free bagels and pastries!

title: Custodial Unlock After-Hours Fee
description: The classroom auto-locked on Friday night with tournament supplies trapped inside.

title: Hardware Accident: Broken Display Remote
description: The smartboard clicker dropped and cracked underfoot during a lively speed round.
